3. PACKING AND MARKING

3.1 Packing - The material shall be packed in clean, dry containers
made of mild steel, tinplatc or fibreboard, or in double hessian bags, with outer hessian 298 Kim" and inner hessian 245 g/mt t both of width 114'30 em and bonded with lOa g/ml bitumen on each run; or in D\\� tarpaulin bags lined with kraft paper of substance 60 g!m!; or in high density polyethylene woven sacks.

3.1.1 When packed in any of the types of bags, they shall be providcd with an internal puJyethylenc liner (of not less than 2JO gauge ), and in the form of It. tubular sheath, bottom sealed. The length and breadth of the Ioose liner shall be 10 percent and 5 percent more respectively than that of the outer bag.
